effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, ＜Recovery +1＞ (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
[Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon card, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, reduce the cost by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
